description: There is a street camera on the Precinct 9 approach the Watch have wanted dark for months. Halloran wants its memory core: not smashed, pulled. Bring back the eye, and prove you'll put your hands on the machine when it counts.
name: Blind Spot

objectives.desc: Pull the memory core from the street camera on the Precinct 9 approach (follow the green GPS line).
emotes: {who} works the camera housing open and lifts out its core; the amber light dies.
